purpose: Follow-up mechanical feasibility assay after the open-jaw v5 grid; not a fresh controller-performance cohort.
action: At the safe preposition, command the declared partially open gripper; keep this command through descent; then close, lift, translate above the observed fixture and hold as in the frozen v5 assay.
boundary: Same recorded visual target interface, original collision geometry/friction/mass/IK, same restored physical checkpoint. No target poses rewritten after initialization. Use v5 timing and physical retention criteria unchanged.
limits: Joint-width targets are actuator calibration priors, not measured contact clearance. Test all entries, retain collision/failure outcomes, and do not select future validation scenes by these outcomes. A retained lift is not completed placement or online learned-policy recovery.
